name: Thorunn D.
headline: Global VP of Alliances and Partnerships @ Talon.One | Partnerships and business strategy expert
about:
As the VP of Partnerships and Managing Director UK at Talon.One, I lead a global team of partner managers across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, and oversee the go-to-market strategy with strategic agency and technology partners. I am responsible for generating new business revenue, growing the pipeline and expanding our partner ecosystem across key markets.

Our key partners include Braze, Shopify, Accenture, Deloitte, Google Cloud, WPP Group, and many more. My team contributes to over 50% of revenue and influences the product roadmap, ensuring that our incentives engine meets the needs and expectations of our customers (Fortune 500 brands).

I am passionate about building and nurturing relationships, solving complex problems and creating innovative solutions. I thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic and collaborative environment, where I can leverage my positive attitude, roll-up-the-sleeves execution ability and go-to-market expertise. My goal is to empower our partners and customers to create sophisticated, highly targeted and scalable loyalty programs with Talon.One.

experiences.description:
Talon.One’s Promotion Engine was created as a response to the limited functionality of available coupon, discount, loyalty, referral, and product bundling tools for scaling businesses and enterprises. 

After a quick one-time integration, businesses can begin building sophisticated, highly targeted promotional campaigns without wasting valuable development resources. Talon.One’s unique all-in-one solution is already empowering worldwide leaders from a wide range of industries such as Ticketmaster, Burger King, Just Eat, and JD Sports.

At Talon.One, I lead a global partnerships team and oversee go-to-market with strategic agency and technology partnerships. Managing a 4+ people team across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, I'm responsible for new business revenue, growing pipeline and expanding our partner ecosystem across key markets. 

On a daily basis, I'm involved in product development + sales & marketing go-to-market initiatives with our key partners like Braze, commercetools, Twilio Segment, mParticle, and many more. This includes technical product alignment & negotiation, activation events across several markets and enablement workshops for our ecosystem of 150+ partners. 

If you are interested in exploring a strategic partnership with Talon.One, reach out to us at partners@talon.one

• Building and leading the EMEA Partner Marketing team, and coordination all activities and campaigns for our 50+ EMEA digital agency and ISV cloud partners.
• Responsible for marketing with-partners, marketing through-partner and marketing-to programs such as playbooks, webinar and event toolkits, joint marketing plans and lead-generation campaigns.

Contentful, the content platform for digital teams to power websites, apps, and devices. Unlike a CMS, Contentful was built to integrate with the modern software stack. It offers a central hub for structured content, powerful management and delivery APIs, and a customizable web app that enables developers and content creators to ship their products faster.

I was hire number 3 in the global partnerships team which by 2020 grew to a team of 10+ people. In my role as Strategic Partnerships Manager EMEA I was responsible for:

• Defining the partnerships strategy and vision. Building an initial partner program in 2016, and relaunching a new program in 2018 to support our growing global partner network.

• Building, managing and growing strategic partnerships with key digital agencies, systems integrators (SI), and digital consultancies across the EMEA region

• Ideated and managed cross-functional projects with Field Marketing and Customer Success, for example, the Contentful Academy, Contentful Essentials and Partner Certification program.

• Created onboarding plans, crafted product trainings & content modeling workshops, sales trainings, certification and led executive MBRs and QBRs, and joint go-to-market plans.
